name: yoooni-daily-plugin
description: Yoooni daily-work toolbox for Claude Code and Codex: 13 skills including the domain-knowledge bootstrap entry, onboarding pipeline, environment setup, team-tool lifecycle, production-log troubleshooting, task spaces, and hook reporting. Includes a SessionStart auto-update hook.
